utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. We’re still gathering donations near the community hall — if you can, just drop them there and I’ll sort them out.

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I’m curious—what are they hoping to fix during the drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I’m running a bit late, but I’ll catch up and help with the urgent, safety-related repairs when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive around the neighborhood, and I’ll point any urgent safety issues your way if I hear about them.

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia. If you hear what they still need, let me know—I can help gather a few things.

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia. Sunday at the community center should work—just let me know if there’s anything I can bring or help set up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m still in for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam — when you arrive, I’ll point you to the most urgent repairs. Appreciate you pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Bo — I’ll head over and wait for your cue. Happy to help with the most urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still a bit fuzzy on the details, honestly—have you heard where they’re collecting the stuff?

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that—if you hear the spot, let me know. I can keep an eye out for any extra tools too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start with Maple and Pine and get the word out fast. Let’s make sure plenty of neighbors show up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out too, though I may need a reminder where to bring things.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — just bring anything you’ve got to the front gate, and I’ll make sure people know where to go. I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It should be over by the community center, near the side lot. If you want, I can double-check the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that would help—please do double-check the exact spot. Once I know, I can work around the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—I’ll check the exact spot and let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, I’m a bit late, but I can still help with the repair drive. Point me to the most urgent repairs and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Dane — I’m a little fuzzy on the latest, but I think the urgent stuff is mostly gathering supplies and checking what still needs fixing. Have you heard where they’re collecting things?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I haven’t heard yet, but I can ask around and find out where they’re collecting things. Once I know, I’ll head there and help with supplies.

utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll send anyone I hear of your way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli — I appreciate it. Just send folks my way, and I’ll keep everyone posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll keep an ear out and send anyone I hear of your way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I can bring nails, screwdrivers, and a few other basics by the community center. Just let me know if there’s anything else you need most.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great, Gus—those basics will definitely help. I’ll swing by after errands and see what else they’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Ira—thanks. I’ll drop them off by the community center and wait to hear if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m still in for the repair drive. I’ll check the front gate, leaky sink, and broken lights first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. I appreciate you checking those repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. A clear list would help me most—tell me what’s still needed and where to bring it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I’ll bring what I can to the community center by Sunday. If you can, send me the list once more so I can double-check my stash.

utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m still all set to help. Send me the confirmed time and I’ll keep the pairings organized.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rosa. What’s the confirmed time on Sunday at the community center, and do you still want me to bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I don’t have the confirmed time yet, but I’ll share it as soon as I get it. Yes please, bring the tools if you can — that would really help.
